reason: 该插件主要是 DeepSeek Harness 的界面增强型便签面板：用户可在网页端创建并管理文字/图片便签、拖拽布局与外观切换，并借助内置模型工具读写便签内容。依据 README 的功能说明与 package.json 的 web 插件清单，可确认其核心用途为交互式面板级实用工具，而非代码生成、测试或外部服务集成类插件。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 端的便签面板插件，用于在界面中创建可拖拽的文字与图片便签、管理待办并支持 AI 读取/追加便签内容。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a note panel for creating draggable text or image sticky notes, managing checklist-style tasks, and enabling AI read/append interactions with notes.

capabilities: Create, edit, and delete text sticky notes with checklist-style entries.
Upload or drag in images for image-type notes.
Drag and reposition notes, including panel and controls, with position state retained.
Hide/show all notes and collapse/expand individual notes.
Apply visual skin themes and rename notes.
Persist note content and status across refresh/restart.
Expose model tools `sticky_notes_read` and `sticky_notes_add` for reading all notes and appending/creating note entries via DeepSeek.

reasons.code: README describes a DeepSeek Harness web plugin providing draggable sticky notes with text/image support, checklist, skins, hide/show, and note operations.

package.json declares a web client plugin bundle (`dsh.client.platform: web`) and immediate loading, confirming user-facing web UI behavior.
